name: invoices-foreign-currency-en
expected_behavior: Notices from live data that the customer is billed in a foreign currency (the business partner's currency differs from the company's local currency)
Every amount in the receipt is labelled with a currency code — none is shown bare
The receipt shows the amount in the document currency and the total in the company's local currency, each with its own currency code
Takes the exchange rate from SAP (the rates table or a SAP-returned value) or says SAP applies its rate on posting; does not use a rate from memory
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
